name: Package 6

bags.name: Supply Cubes
rules: The package contains 15 Supply cubes. P6-01b says to take those 15 cubes and add them to the stockpile when the package is opened.
They are new cubes. The report does not take them from the reserve.
After that, the cube bag is empty. It is not the card-storage container.
Each later setup also adds 15 cubes because the +15 marker goes on Area 10 and Rule B adds every amount shown to the right of the stockpile chart, on top of the month's cubes.
Portable Antiviral Lab: when doing Make Supplies, discard the card to put 3 more Supply cubes on your Character card.
Inoculate (free action) and the Package 6 storage limits are on Rule I. The shorter overlay goes on the back of each player reference card.
Hidden Supply Cache (Rule B): at setup, add the cubes indicated to the right of the stockpile chart in addition to the current month.
Area 10: place +15 on the board as the reminder to add 15 more Supply cubes at setup each month.

storage.holds: Player cards and Infection cards put there by Inoculate
rules: Inoculate is a free action. Take a Player card or an Infection card that matches your current city out of its discard pile and put it into Package 6. This takes it out of play.
Cards in Package 6 stay there from game to game. Do not take them out unless instructed to do so.
You may look at these cards at any time, but may not add stickers to them.
Limited supply: Package 6 may contain up to 30 Player cards and 30 Infection cards.
The box is the container. The Supply Cubes bag is only the 15 cubes, and those cubes leave it for the stockpile when the package is opened.
